svg.aria-label: Exploration sidebar redesign at its real 360 pixel width: one 'one row per' unit selector replacing the mode segments plus the rank dropdown, one list whose chrome is invariant and whose rows carry at most two subtitles, details that replace the list, and the loading, empty, error, capped and messy-data states.
svg.text: Exploration sidebar — one unit selector, one list, one detail
Drawn at the shipped 360 px column width. Every name, count and span is read from the shipped snapshot: Maastrichtian, whole map in view (5,064 occurrences · 2,439 localities · 378 genera).
A · DEFAULT LIST — ONE ROW PER GENUS
B · ONE ROW PER OCCURRENCE (CAPPED)
C · ONE ROW PER LOCALITY
D · A ROW OPENED — DETAIL REPLACES LIST

g.text: Showing the first 300 of 378 — zoom in to narrow the view.

svg.text: Two subtitles at most, and the clade word is gone from the row: the tint carries it, the detail names it. Rows are ordered by count, so the cap cuts the rare tail.
Records that do not classify at the tier are filtered out of the taxon units entirely — 2,898 of 5,064 at genus — and stay visible under Occurrence and Locality.

g.text: Showing the first 300 of 5,064 — zoom in to narrow the view.

svg.text: The chrome is identical to A. Only the row body changes: an occurrence names the Ma range and the collection it comes from instead of a count.
Formation was the third subtitle and is now a field of the occurrence detail (I), where "Formation not recorded" remains the explicit missing label (charter §2).

g.text: Showing the first 300 of 2,439 — zoom in to narrow the view.

svg.text: A locality is a place, not a clade, so it carries no clade rule. Its two subtitles are the distinct-taxon count and the present-day region as the snapshot records it.
Formation, occurrence count and Ma span left the row for the detail (K). Collection names run long and truncate, with the full name in the row's title (charter §6).
The unit selector never moves: the user always knows what a row is, even inside a detail. The back link names the list it returns to.
Selecting a point on the map lands here too — the map keeps its focus/dim, so the detail is evidence, not a second copy of it.
E · LOADING A STAGE
F · EMPTY — NO OCCURRENCES AT THIS AGE
G · ERROR — STAGE FAILED TO LOAD
H · EMPTY IN VIEW (RECOVERABLE)

g.text: 66–72.2 Ma ≈ · La Mata del Viudà tracksite
66–83.6 Ma ≈ · SDNHM Loc. 3405 - Carlsbad area, o…
Mode and rank were two controls answering
one question. Five units, one flat set, one
choice. No control appears or disappears.
Header, count, cap notice, empty-in-view and
highlight are the same code for every unit.
A row body is a name and at most two values:
count · Ma span (taxa), Ma span · collection
A detail no longer pushes the list down a
360 px scroll column. Back is one action and
restores the scroll position and the row.
The clade word and the formation live here.
Records that reach no taxon at the tier —
2,898 of 5,064 at genus — are filtered out of
list, count and map together at Genus, Family
and Major group. Occurrence and Locality keep
Alphabetical order plus a 300-row cap hid
